ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) central regions comprising approximately 70-75% of visible surface area, contrasted against low-intensity (black) peripheral margins and scattered localized dark pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, high-intensity contiguous white regions occupy the central interior of both lobes. A low-intensity black border follows the trailing edge. Diffuse yellowish-brown mottling is localized in the center-right lobe. Small, high-contrast dark clusters are concentrated on the distal margin of the left lobe and lower right fluke boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an estimated aperture of 40-50 degrees and a vertical depth approximately 20% of the fluke's visible height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge; amplitude is lowest near the median notch and highest on the distal left lobe where it transitions into a jagged, irregular boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the outer margins, sweeping upward and outward to acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed cluster of circular, high-contrast white and dark nodes (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme outer edge of the left lobe tip; additional smaller clusters scattered along the lower edge of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, sub-parallel yellowish linear pixel disruptions visible on the white field of the right lobe, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, irregular calcified growth or heavy barnacle encrustation on the distal tip of the left fluke, significantly altering the expected geometric contour compared to the right tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant atmospheric occlusion due to high-velocity water spray and droplets across the foreground, particularly masking the fluke-water interface.
